text:
Example:


Player 1: Why did you buy chocolate ice cream?
Player 2: When we were on holiday last summer, why did you buy chocolate ice cream?

Player 2: Whose are those shoes?
Player 1: Whose are those shoes lying under the table?

Player 1: Which is your favourite crisp flavour?
Player 2: If you had to choose between Prawn Cocktail and Salt and Vinegar, which is your favourite crisp flavour?

What to do:

  1. Player 1 asks a question.
  2. Player 2 repeats the question but adds extra information in to extend the question. You can add it at the start or the end!
  3. Swap over a few times so both players have a go at asking and extending several questions. Try to use a different question word each time.
